decision_reason: This is the USGS MODFLOW API Agricultural Water Use Package (API-Ag), a public Python library with installation instructions, documentation and example models. The USGS-authored research article describes and validates the exact package, and source is publicly available under the OSI-approved Unlicense. However, the GitLab/GitHub source has had no substantive code updates since September 2023 and no current product-specific use, support statement or maintenance signal was found. Hold on freshness pending such evidence.

decision_reason: The assigned USGS DSAS repo is an actively maintained, versioned shoreline-change application with official deployment/distribution, user documentation and global government/scientific use. Public code is present in historical v5.1 source and, importantly, the current v6.2.104 source archive on the non-default v6.2prelim branch (the default/master and v6.1 tag mainly expose installers). The repo and source archive grant CC0-1.0 worldwide; a NOTICE requests attribution but explicitly says use remains subject to the license. The first defensible licensed source is 2020.
